mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS 3-month change falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in declining rate periods.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, prompting equity investors to anticipate reduced corporate earnings and lower forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous acceleration in CPIAUCSL above 3.0% YoY and FEDFUNDS above 2.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction signal (CPIAUCSL>3.0% AND FEDFUNDS>2.0%) fails to produce negative returns in more than 40% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL < 2.5% YoY), a housing market expansion above 900 thousand units signals robust consumer demand and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Signal (HOUST>900) fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL<2.5%, or Rank IC for signal in regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 90.0 (index, 2017=100) indicates manufacturing sector contraction, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO<90.0, or Rank IC for INDPRO signal is below 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.0%) combined with weak consumer spending (RSAFS < 400,000 million dollars) indicates dual stress in labor and consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: dual stress: labor and consumer demand
failure_condition: Interaction signal (UNRATE>5.0% AND RSAFS<400000.0) fails to produce negative returns in more than 40% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market expansion above 950 thousand units (HOUST > 950) signals robust consumer confidence and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST>950, or Rank IC for HOUST signal is below 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), a rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Signal (FEDFUNDS>0.5%) fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL>3.0%, or Rank IC for signal in regime is below 0.03.
